i.norm: Tests the Match Rating Approach (MRA) phonetic comparison algorithm for names that sound alike but differ in spelling. The MRA algorithm encodes names by removing vowels (except at word start), collapsing double consonants, and retaining the first and last three letters before comparing similarity ratings.

"Oona" and "Oonagh" are phonetic variants of the same Irish name. The MRA algorithm should recognise them as equivalent because, after encoding, their similarity rating meets the minimum threshold required for a successful match.
